posts.author: Son_ofHiro
posts.body:
And if you don't find what you are looking for you can also use any image editing tool to edit the dragon's colour using filter.
And if you want an attack to happen by force, you need to do eventing in the troops tab in the database.
Go to database and select troop tab, click on the event page and find "Force Action".
Select the enemy you want it to attack and select the skill you want it to use to attack.
And you need to set the conditions on the troop event page for it to run. By default it is set to "don't run". Click there and select turn. Make sure you set the turn to zero for the event to run before player can attack.
